name: Scenario Chart Gallery (mock)
description: Mock data for nine kinds of scenario comparison, shaped like figures from the scenario-planning literature, one bundle of nine CSV tables, each row's scenario in its case column: carpark_occupancy.csv (carpark occupancy by hour, weekday and off day); fragility_curves.csv (bridge fragility curves, as built and retrofitted); bridge_damage.csv (bridge damage states for m5, m6 and m7 events); pga_ensemble.csv (median pga of each simulated scenario, m5, m6 and m7); carbon_by_distance.csv (fleet carbon emission by trip distance, four priorities); lifecycle_gwp.csv (building gwp by lifecycle stage, baseline and proposal); impact_share.csv (structural share of two solutions' environmental impact); route_criteria.csv (criteria weighing for or against three routes); green_wall.csv (green-wall systems' u-value, energy savings and co2 reduction). The ScenarioCharts test dataflow loads it and compares each table's scenarios on a Vega-Lite node. The values are invented, not measured.
